title: QCrypton PQC Scanner
descriptionMarkdown: The **QCrypton PQC Scanner** connector ingests post-quantum cryptography readiness findings from your Azure environment into Microsoft Sentinel. Findings include Key Vault key posture (RSA/ECC vs. PQ-hybrid), TLS certificate signature algorithms on public endpoints, Storage Account and App Service TLS configuration, and CMK provenance. Deploy the QCrypton PQC Scanner container into your subscription; it enumerates via Azure Resource Graph and writes to the `PQReadiness_CL` custom table via a Data Collection Rule (DCR).
additionalRequirementBanner: This data connector depends on the `PQReadiness_CL` custom log table being provisioned in your Log Analytics workspace. The provisioning ARM template is included in this solution package and runs automatically at solution install time.

sampleQueries.description: All quantum-vulnerable findings in the last 24h
sampleQueries.query:
PQReadiness_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where QuantumPosture == 'vulnerable'
| project TimeGenerated, ResourceName, AssetKind, Algorithm, PostureReason, RiskScore
| order by RiskScore desc

sampleQueries.description: Vulnerable Key Vault keys grouped by subscription
sampleQueries.query:
PQReadiness_CL
| where AssetKind == 'kv-key' and QuantumPosture == 'vulnerable'
| summarize count() by SubscriptionId, Algorithm

sampleQueries.description: TLS certs expiring after 2030 still using classical signatures
sampleQueries.query:
PQReadiness_CL
| where AssetKind in ('tls-cert', 'kv-cert') and QuantumPosture == 'vulnerable'
| where ExpiresOn > datetime(2030-01-01)
| project ResourceName, AssetIdentifier, SignatureAlgorithm, ExpiresOn, RiskScore

dataTypes.name: PQReadiness_CL
dataTypes.lastDataReceivedQuery:
PQReadiness_CL
            | summarize Time = max(TimeGenerated)
            | where isnotempty(Time)

value:
PQReadiness_CL
            | summarize LastLogReceived = max(TimeGenerated)
            | project IsConnected = LastLogReceived > ago(1h)

resourceProvider.permissionsDisplayText: read and write permissions are required.

read permissions to shared keys for the workspace are required. [See the documentation to learn more about workspace keys](https://docs.microsoft.com/azure/azure-monitor/platform/agent-windows#obtain-workspace-id-and-key).

customs.name: Azure subscription reader + Key Vault reader + Monitoring Metrics Publisher
customs.description: The QCrypton PQC Scanner container-app managed identity requires **Reader** at each target subscription scope (to enumerate resources via Azure Resource Graph), **Key Vault Reader** on the vaults to be scanned, and **Monitoring Metrics Publisher** on the Data Collection Rule (DCR) to write findings via the Logs Ingestion API.

instructionSteps.title: 1. Solution template — automatic provisioning
instructionSteps.description:
Installing this solution provisions the `PQReadiness_CL` custom table, the Data Collection Endpoint (DCE), and the Data Collection Rule (DCR) automatically. After deployment, capture the following values from the deployment outputs — you will pass them to the QCrypton PQC Scanner container in the next step:

- **`dceEndpoint`** — logs ingestion URL of the provisioned DCE
- **`dcrImmutableId`** — immutable ID of the provisioned DCR
- **`customTable`** — always `PQReadiness_CL`

Find them under **Deployments → this deployment → Outputs** in the Azure portal.

instructionSteps.title: 2. Deploy the QCrypton PQC Scanner container
instructionSteps.description:
Deploy the scanner container into a resource group in the same subscription (or one federated to the target subscription via managed identity). See [github.com/gunjanmj/qcrypton-shopline/tree/main/pqc-scanner-azure](https://github.com/gunjanmj/qcrypton-shopline/tree/main/pqc-scanner-azure) for the Bicep template. Grant the container's managed identity **Reader** at each target subscription scope, **Key Vault Reader** on target vaults, and **Monitoring Metrics Publisher** on the Data Collection Rule (DCR) provisioned in step 1.

When configuring the container, set these environment variables using the values from step 1:

- `DCE_ENDPOINT` = the `dceEndpoint` output
- `DCR_IMMUTABLE_ID` = the `dcrImmutableId` output
- `DCR_STREAM_NAME` = `Custom-PQReadiness_CL`
- `TARGET_WORKSPACE_ID` = the Workspace ID shown below

instructionSteps.title: 3. Verify ingestion
instructionSteps.description:
After the container has run at least once (default cadence: hourly), verify data is arriving:

```kql
PQReadiness_CL
| summarize count(), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by AssetKind
```

If no rows return within 60 minutes, check the container logs for authentication errors against the DCE endpoint. The connector's **Status** on this page will flip to **Connected** once findings land in `PQReadiness_CL`.
